contracts.name: row parser
contracts.seh: outer try/finally; per-field try/except for MJD, RA, Dec, V/Z (0x405430/0x405840); ID, comment and c-derivation outside except
contracts.fact: ID Copy(1,11) right-trimmed → string[15]; MJD token (prefix from current date; not reconstructible); RA h/m/s → (abs32(h)+m/60+s/3600)·(+1) Extended @+0x18; Dec d/m/s with sign 0x485960 (x<0 → −1), caller abs32 at 0x57b72b, @+0x22; abs32 = two's-complement cdq/xor/sub on the signed DWORD, so abs32(−2^31) = −2^31 (RA −2147483648 h; Dec +2147483648°); minutes are not abs'd; V or Z Single @+0x30/+0x2c then z=Single(v/c) or v=Single(c·z), c Extended 2db29defa70e62921140; comment token → string[36]; +0x34=0.

numericPolicy.VZ: binary32 exact: decimal → binary32 by BigInt correct rounding (native 0x40cf60 not proven correctly rounded; relative distance < 2^-58 from a binary32 midpoint flagged); z=round24(round64(v/c)), v=round24(round64(c·z)) under control word 0x1332 (PC extended, RC nearest-even) — host control word not witnessed; c·z binary32 overflow = native unhandled fault → file refused.
numericPolicy.projection: Number: RA hours in binary64 with the original operation order; Math.sin/Math.cos for FSIN/FCOS; FISTP Round as nearest-even; values within 1e-6 px of a .5 tie flagged.
numericPolicy.int32Abs: RA hours / Dec degrees: admitted signed int32 only (otherwise unadmitted, raw kept); wedgeAbsInt32 reproduces the integer cdq/xor/sub step exactly (−2^31 stays −2^31); the d/m/s sum then uses Number in the original order ((abs32(d)+m/60)+s/3600)·sign, not 80-bit Extended; FSIN reduction of the resulting huge angles is not claimed.
numericPolicy.svgArc: wedgeFrame keeps the recovered GDI Arc direction points (endX,endY); wedgeArcSvgEnd/wedgeArcSvgPath (pure core) project them onto radius r with atan2/cos/sin for an SVG minor arc, sweep-flag 0, 3 decimals. SVG approximation only; not GDI pixels. Paths unchanged by the 2026-10-21 review-fix move (golden strings in tests).
numericPolicy.labels: FloatToStrF(…,ffFixed,18,2) emitted with '.'; host DecimalSeparator not recovered.
numericPolicy.claim: No x87, GDI, font or colour equivalence is claimed.

admission.bytes: 0x20-0x7e, 0xb0, LF, CRLF; ≤512 KiB; ≤1024 bytes per line; ≤2000 data rows; ≤10000 workspace records

fieldStatuses.native-zero-fill: empty field; original stores 0; not plotted
fieldStatuses.unadmitted: spelling outside the strict decimal/integer grammar; native outcome not asserted; not plotted

admission.separator: explicit user choice '.' or ',' recorded per file; native DecimalSeparator (byte 0x5b880f) host-dependent

deviations: Whole file is validated before the add/clear prompt and applied atomically (native asks first and can be left partial or with an open file).
Rows with native zero-fill or unadmitted RA/V/Z are listed but not plotted; 'Points Plotted' counts admitted rows (native counts every list entry).
Points whose ellipse lies wholly outside 0..550 are reported, not drawn; exact TImage clip insets not recovered.

Recovered colour scheme 0 is the default display and scheme 1 is offered as a view option (the original only shows it while printing; its display default depends on the historical host's Env+0x2e8e value, which is unknown). Fonts are approximate; the dashed selection ring is new.
Transparent enlarged hit areas make points clickable; the drawn radius is the recovered size.

mjd: Raw MJD token text is preserved exactly as saved; the original's date prefix (taken from the loading session's current date) is absent from the file and is not constructed; no MJD value is computed. This is not a full native record-metadata loader.

newUiBehaviour.presentationCatalog: src/components/WedgeMessages.ts: WedgeMessageOverrides widens strings, nested groups, tuples and formatters; WEDGE_NATIVE_CAPTIONS defaults = verbatim WEDGE_NATIVE_TEXT (source evidence, never translated). Figure-drawn text stays native.
newUiBehaviour.hostInactivity: disabled prop → suspendWedgeWorkspace (src/core/wedgeWorkspace.ts): aborts the read (token no longer matches), drops pending import consent and the options draft; keeps records, receipts, committed options, separator, selection. Not an original behaviour.
newUiBehaviour.keyboard: Escape = non-destructive prompt answer (Cancel at Retain, No at Confirm Deletion; never deletes); focus returns to the enabled file input after a prompt answer or read cancel, never during host inactivity or when focus has left the panel; Options tab trap uses one stop per radio group (checked radio). Native keyboard behaviour not recovered.
newUiBehaviour.optionsModality: While the aria-modal Options dialog is open the rest of the panel is inert, the file input is disabled and onFile refuses any change event, so no read or import consent can start underneath it (Options itself is disabled during a read or consent). Closing Options returns focus to the Options button. The coordinator reports the native options form as modal; no ShowModal call address is cited here, and this is a web accessibility boundary, not a claim of runtime parity.
newUiBehaviour.consentAnnouncement: A waiting import question (both stages) is appended to the existing polite role=status line through the presentation-catalog formatter awaitingAnswer and the pure wedgeStatusText; it never moves focus. A panel control the read itself disabled is not treated as deliberate focus. Web wording, not an original string; DOM/live-region checks only, not screen-reader runs.
newUiBehaviour.persistence: In-memory workspace only; visible warning that it is not included in Save investigation and is discarded on reload/close; sources can be loaded again. No persistence format.

controls.nature: Synthetic vectors and hand-derived pixels/IEEE encodings; not observations, not original output, not a runtime oracle.
